summary: Iteration 2 focused on the bug-fix verification (native FileSystem.uploadAsync path can't be exercised on web, so backend /api/files is validated instead) plus regression of the full pipeline and the new /api/sample-template endpoint. Added /app/backend/tests/test_upload_formats.py with 9 targeted tests. All 9 new tests pass. Full suite (33 tests) also passes when run sequentially (`pytest -n0`). Two failures observed only in parallel mode of the whole suite are cross-worker token-rotation interference between TestTokenRotation and other suites, not product bugs. Backend /api/files correctly accepts .xlsx (sheets=['Sheet1']), .xls (sheets=['Sheet1']), .csv (sheets=['CSV']), and rejects .txt/.pdf with 400. Missing/invalid X-Gateway-Token returns 403. Full CSV pipeline (upload -> columns -> validate summary total/valid/invalid/duplicate/empty -> batch -> next -> jobs result idempotent w/ duplicate_ignored -> batch counts -> export xlsx) passes end-to-end. New GET /api/sample-template returns a valid xlsx with 'Mobile Number' and 'Message' columns and correct Content-Disposition, no auth required. Frontend web smoke test (mobile viewport 390x844): Upload tab loads without runtime errors, dropzone visible, testIDs pick-file-button and download-sample present, 'Sample template download karein' link renders, and all four tabs (Dashboard/Upload/History/Settings) navigate cleanly. Only non-blocking console warning is the previously reported 'shadow* style props deprecated' from RN Web 0.19+. Native Android FileSystem.uploadAsync path cannot be exercised on web preview per the reviewer's own note — final on-device verification is expected to be performed by the user on their next Android build.

minor.issue: When the full suite runs in parallel, TestTokenRotation.test_regenerate_rotates rotates the gateway token mid-run and other workers using the module-scoped token fixture then get 403. Non-product bug: run with `pytest -n0` or restore the previous token at teardown.

issues: Non-blocking RN Web warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow (already reported in iteration_1).

action_items: Native-only verification: on next Android build, confirm the compiled app no longer emits 'Unsupported FormDataPart implementation' and that FileSystem.uploadAsync -> POST /api/files succeeds for .xlsx/.xls/.csv (backend contract verified here).
Optional test-quality cleanup: make TestTokenRotation restore the original token in a teardown so the whole suite is parallel-safe.
Optional (carry-over): migrate `shadow*` -> `boxShadow` and `props.pointerEvents` -> `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN Web deprecations.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts upload path is correct: Web branch uses FormData with Blob/File; native branch uses expo-file-system/legacy FileSystem.uploadAsync with fieldName 'file' and mimeType passed through - matches the FastAPI UploadFile parameter name.

Backend /api/files enforces .xlsx/.xls/.csv extension check, 15MB size cap, sheet-name detection (CSV -> ['CSV']), and audits each upload. Contract {file_id, filename, sheets} verified for all 3 file types.
GET /api/sample-template is unauthenticated (public helper) and returns a proper xlsx with correct MIME + Content-Disposition. Acceptable design choice for a downloadable template.
Duplicate result reporting on /api/jobs/{id}/result correctly returns duplicate_ignored: true via find_one_and_update guarded by status:'SENDING'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for web smoke - Upload screen and all 4 tabs render, testIDs present. Native Android path not testable on web preview by design.

seed_data_creation: test_upload_formats.py uploads TEST_-prefixed xlsx/xls/csv rows and completes one CSV batch (1 message marked SENT simulated). Safe to leave (TEST_ prefix).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL from frontend/.env EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Token obtained via POST /api/gateway/setup (idempotent). Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -n0` to avoid the cross-worker token rotation flakiness. CSV uploads present sheet name 'CSV'. The native Android FormData bug can only be verified on a compiled Android build - backend contract is confirmed here for all 3 formats.
rca_of_issue: Reported bug 'Unsupported FormDataPart implementation' was a native React Native fetch limitation with non-standard FormDataPart shapes. Fix in api.ts uses FileSystem.uploadAsync on native (streams file directly as multipart with fieldName='file'), which bypasses the RN fetch's stricter FormData validation. Backend /api/files endpoint is unchanged and verified to accept the exact multipart request both paths produce. Web path unchanged - real Blob/File appended to FormData.
